FEAT-2-S121.title: Define Specialty Identification Schema and Contract
FEAT-2-S121.description: Create Pydantic models defining input (user query, optional context) and output (NUCC codes, labels, confidence scores) for specialty identification to standardize interaction across tool_router and services.

FEAT-2-S122.title: Add Confidence Scoring and Ranking to Specialty Mapping
FEAT-2-S122.description: Extend specialty_service to assign confidence scores to matched NUCC codes and rank results, combining regex and vector outputs into a deterministic ordered list.

FEAT-2-S123.title: Implement Low-Confidence and No-Match Fallback Handling
FEAT-2-S123.description: Add logic to detect low-confidence or empty matches and trigger safe fallback behavior (e.g., broadened taxonomy classification) without breaking downstream provider search.

FEAT-2-S124.title: Contract Tests for Specialty Identification Tool Interface
FEAT-2-S124.description: Create tests validating that tool_router inputs and outputs conform strictly to the defined schema, including malformed inputs, missing fields, and multi-specialty responses.
